    parent: LN,
    remove_brackets_around_comma: bool = False,

        or is_empty_tuple(node)
        or is_one_tuple(node)

            syms.expr_stmt,
            syms.assert_stmt,
            syms.return_stmt,

            syms.tname,

            syms.for_stmt,
            syms.del_stmt,
            syms.for_stmt,

    last = node.children[-1]

            middle,
            parent=parent,

        )
